detail.longDescription: RE: https:// pkm.social/@stephane/117103866 282092127 This text capture ➡️ send app looks promising! It’s Mac only at the moment. If they open it to iOS it could become a Drafts competitor. FYI I’m giving initial thoughts as someone who hasn’t used it yet. So far I’m impressed with their approach. Even the cookies screen was well thought out, informative and polite! Keep an eye on this one. # obsidian # pkm # plaintext # productivity # app
